answer: Resist sybils with a pulse check: every identity must answer a fresh, unpredictable micro-task drawn from recent chain state within a short window. Tasks cannot be precomputed or batched, so one operator running fifty clones must do fifty times the live work. Two independent peers must then echo each result, and matching echoes from the same cluster expose clones. Trust grows like a cedar: weight accrues only from a long public history of verified work with many distinct counterparties, so a new identity starts near zero and fifty mature roots cost fifty genuine histories.
